invariants.rationale: The returned map result should never be null; mapToPair should always return a non-null map.
The method expects a non-null writeResult to produce a valid mapping.
All entries in the map should correspond to a non-null partition path from status.getStat().getPartitionPath().
Each value (list of file IDs) should not be null, as getAllExistingFileIds should return a non-null list.
Each unique partition path in the write statuses corresponds to exactly one entry in the resulting map.
